answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 25389 Country: India Title: I CAN USE PERFUME . BODY SPRAY Question: I CAN USE PERFUME . BODY SPRAY Answer ID: 25389 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1436/1436/M=1431) You can use it if the perfume does not contain haram and impure alcohol, otherwise not. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
